title: Scaling of Fourier coefficients
statement: For an integer $n\ge 0$, a real-valued function $f$ on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, a real constant $c$, and a subset $S$ of the coordinates, the Fourier coefficient of $x\mapsto c f(x)$ at $S$ is $c$ times the Fourier coefficient of $f$ at $S$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is real-valued on the sign cube of dimension $n$
